request.subject: UNIT:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only one thing: the big pointed crimson shield with the gold lion becomes a small plain round wooden buckler, about 16 pixels across, of light brown planks with a steel rim and a round steel boss, held low at his side, so his whole tunic and both legs show; no lion and no paint on it. Do not redraw anything else: keep the helmet, crest, face, sword, surcoat with the gold cross, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
